notes.title: Goldfish Syndrome Demo is Out For The Steam VN Festival!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504734/e36d5cf2ff6fdd3a52bccecd40b1d352bcb5c419.png[/img]
Greetings! We are [b]California Beef Noodle Studio[/b].

[b]Goldfish Syndrome[/b] is our very first visual novel, and we’ve poured our hearts and souls into it. The demo is now available for download, and all information relevant will be showcased on the Steam Visual Novel Fest event page.[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534570/_Goldfish_Syndrome_Demo]Link to Demo's Steam Page[/url]

The story of Goldfish Syndrome takes place in Tokyo, Japan, 2021, centering around MCNP counselor Honda Gaku and several girls with different backgrounds. But there’s far more to it than just that! We’ve worked hard to bring out each character’s personality and the nuances of their relationships in every word and every pixel of the game—so keep an eye out as you play!

This demo features four selected segments from the full game, offering a glimpse into the overall atmosphere, character dynamics, and more. Their stories of love, hatred, and entanglement will gradually unfold in the future—along with a few secrets best left unsaid…

If you enjoy our work, we’d love for you to [b]“[u]Add to Wishlist[/u]”[/b] or share your excitement on [b]social media[/b]! [b]Much love <3[/b]

Lastly, as we refine the full game and introduce new mechanics, we urgently need feedback from players like you! Whether by filling out a short survey or joining our [b]Discord server[/b] and [b]official QQ group[/b], every bit of input helps us immensely.

[b]We look forward to meeting you![/b]
